an4.255:1.3: There is the case where a person, being subject himself to aging, seeks (happiness in) what is subject to aging.
an4.255:1.4: Being subject himself to illness, he seeks (happiness in) what is subject to illness.
an4.255:1.5: Being subject himself to death, he seeks (happiness in) what is subject to death.
an4.255:1.6: Being subject himself to defilement, he seeks (happiness in) what is subject to defilement.
an4.255:2.3: There is the case where a person, being subject himself to aging, realizing the drawbacks of what is subject to aging, seeks the unaging, unsurpassed rest from the yoke: unbinding.
an4.255:2.4: Being subject himself to illness, realizing the drawbacks of what is subject to illness, he seeks the unailing, unsurpassed rest from the yoke: unbinding.
an4.255:2.5: Being subject himself to death, realizing the drawbacks of what is subject to death, he seeks the undying, unsurpassed rest from the yoke: unbinding.
an4.255:2.6: Being subject himself to defilement, realizing the drawbacks of what is subject to defilement, he seeks the undefiled, unsurpassed rest from the yoke: unbinding.
